summary: We are Team Eldoret from Kenya - 3 Junior Astronauts training for 14 Days on the Moon. Our Moon Trainer teaches kids how to survive the Lunar Night (14 days = 336 hours, no Sun). Using NASA POWER API + NASA Artemis data, we learn how much energy we need. Our real home system in Eldoret: SOLAR MAX Hybrid Inverter + Battery + Solar Panel. In the day, solar charges the battery. At night, the battery gives power. Same as Moon! We tested in Kaptumo, Oct 2024: Powered 4 homes LEDs + 6 phones for 8 hours. Kids learn: 1. Check weather (NASA POWER) 2. Save energy 3. Survive night 4. Be brave. Team Eldoret - We are ready for the Moon!
details:
WHAT IT DOES:

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a 14-day Moon survival training game for kids. Astronauts learn to survive the Lunar Night - 14 days with no Sun, 336 hours of darkness.

HOW IT WORKS:

1. Day 1-14: Check NASA POWER API for sun and weather in Eldoret

2. Daytime: Solar panel charges battery (SOLAR MAX Hybrid Inverter system)

3. Nighttime: Battery powers lights and phones, no Sun needed

4. Kids must save energy, check battery %, and make smart choices to survive all 14 days

REAL TEST IN KENYA:

In Kaptumo, Oct 2024, our system powered 4 homes LEDs + 6 phones for 8 hours using solar + battery. This proves our Moon idea works on Earth too.

TOOLS USED:

NASA POWER API, NASA Artemis data, Google Slides, SOLAR MAX Hybrid Inverter, Solar Panel, Battery, Phone

WHY IT IS CREATIVE:

We use a real home in Eldoret to teach Moon science. Kids in Kenya can touch the solar system and understand the Moon. No expensive lab needed.

IMPACT:

Kids learn energy, science, and bravery. They learn how to live on the Moon and how to help their village with solar power. By
